translations.纸带上的点，怎样变成速度和加速度？: How do dots on a tape become velocity and acceleration?
translations.从固定打点周期到纸带读数，沿四条教材实验路径学会记录时间、测量速度和研究加速度。: Follow four textbook paths from periodic dots to tape measurements, velocity and acceleration.
translations.先让时间留下等间隔的点: Let a regular clock mark the tape
translations.选一段纸带，读出这一段的平均速度: Select a tape interval and measure its average velocity
translations.把纸带速度逐点放回时间轴: Place tape velocities on their time axis
translations.同样的计时器，换成竖直下落的重物: Use the same timer for a falling mass
translations.计时器固定，纸带跟随小车或下落重物移动，按真实采样时刻留下点: The fixed timer marks a moving tape at actual sample times
translations.按实际位移绘制的纸带点迹与所选时间区间: Recorded tape dots and a selected time interval
translations.由相邻采样间隔测得的速度与时间图像: Velocity versus time from neighboring samples
translations.点是计时记录，不是物体每一瞬间的位置。图示慢放；读数使用真实秒数。: Dots are timed samples, not every instant of motion. The view is slowed; readings use physical seconds.
translations.竖直纸带随重物下落，新点留在固定针尖处: Vertical tape moves with the falling mass; new marks form at the fixed needle
translations.固定计时器记录移动纸带，同一条纸带连接运动物体: A stationary timer marks one tape connected to the moving object
translations.等时间点距比较：更快但仍然匀速: Equal-time marks: faster motion can still be uniform
translations.同一纸带上用实际采样端点测位移和时间: Displacement and time are read between sampled endpoints on one tape
translations.等时位移得到的速度标在区间中点，等速度增量形成直线: Velocities from equal-time displacements lie at interval midpoints and have equal increments
translations.只用已见的点距推算下一段，随后核对新点: Predict the next gap from the known gaps, then reveal the new mark
translations.同一纸带的等时段移到共同起点，长度成为速度证据: Equal-time sections of the same tape align at a common origin; length gives velocity
translations.让纸带回答问题: Read the evidence in the tape
translations.目标时刻两侧的间隔数: Ticks on each side of the target
translations.模型条件与真实实验: Model conditions and the real experiment
translations.所有点来自同一个理想运动模型，不是独立实测数据。图中慢放，读数使用真实秒。小车给: Every dot comes from one ideal motion model, not an independent measurement. Playback is slowed; readings use physical seconds. Cart acceleration is prescribed: hanger weight is not identified with string tension. Free fall neglects air and tape resistance.
translations.真实测量需检查打点频率、舍去模糊点迹并重复记录。缩短区间会放大读尺误差；两侧最近: Check the real marking frequency, discard unclear marks and repeat recordings. Shorter intervals magnify ruler error. The nearest recorded dots on either side span 0.04 s; screen interpolation does not create finer measurements.
translations.同样的节拍，为什么点越来越疏？: Why do gaps grow when the ticking stays steady?
translations.跟踪同一串等时点，从点距读出速度变化，用等时位移差推导加速度，再预测小车和下落重: Follow one equal-time tape record, infer velocity and acceleration, then predict the next mark for a cart and a falling mass.

cues.title: 同节拍，不同点距
cues.caption: 快而均匀，仍然是匀速。
cues.captionEn: Fast and steady is still uniform.
cues.zh: 同样的节拍，为什么点距不一样？先比较两条匀速纸带：快的一条，点更疏，但间距仍相等。看固定针尖，每隔零点零二秒留下一个新点，旧点随纸带移动。五个间隔共零点一秒，要数六个点。因此，点很疏只能说明这段时间走得远；要判断加速，还得看点距是否继续增加。
cues.en: Why can the gaps differ when the ticking stays steady? Compare two tapes moving at constant speeds. The faster tape has wider but still equal gaps. At the fixed needle, a new dot appears every zero point zero two seconds; older dots move with the paper. Five intervals take one tenth of a second and require six dots. Wide gaps show distance travelled, while growing gaps reveal increasing speed.

cues.title: 一段时间，一段位移
cues.caption: 等时段越长，平均速度越大。
cues.captionEn: A longer equal-time strip means faster motion.
cues.zh: 现在追踪同一条变速纸带。从零点二秒到零点四秒，量出两端位移，再数十个小间隔，得到零点二秒。位移除以时间，就是这一段的平均速度。把区间移到零点六秒以后：时间仍是零点二秒，纸带却更长，平均速度也更大。这个数属于整段，不能直接贴到某一个点上。
cues.en: Follow one changing-motion record. Between zero point two and zero point four seconds, measure the displacement and count ten small intervals: zero point two seconds. Divide distance by time for the interval average. Move to the later interval. The same duration now covers more tape, so the average is larger. This number describes the whole interval, not an arbitrary individual dot.

cues.title: 盯住同一个时刻
cues.caption: 缩小区间，仍保留采样边界。
cues.captionEn: Narrow the interval; respect the sampling limit.
cues.zh: 如果只问零点五秒时有多快呢？固定蓝色目标点，让金色区间从两侧缩小。有限区间的平均速度，逐渐靠近模型算出的瞬时速度。这里故意采用非匀加速运动，所以平均值不总等于中点值。最后只剩目标两侧最近的记录，仍相隔零点零四秒。屏幕能继续放大，却不能凭空补出仪器没有采到的点。
cues.en: How fast is the tape at exactly half a second? Keep the blue target fixed and bring the gold endpoints closer on both sides. The finite-interval average approaches the instantaneous model value. This motion has nonconstant acceleration, so midpoint equality is not automatic. The nearest recorded neighbors still span zero point zero four seconds. Magnifying the screen cannot create samples the instrument never recorded.

cues.title: 从等时纸带到加速度
cues.caption: 等时段等量增长，预测下一点。
cues.captionEn: Equal gap increments predict the next mark.
cues.zh: 小车拉着纸带前进，针尖仍按固定节拍记录。每五个间隔取一段，各历时零点一秒。把这些原来的段移到共同起点，长度依次是一点五、二点一、二点七、三点三厘米。除以同样的时间，就得到逐段速度。每次速度增加零点零六米每秒，除以零点一秒，加速度是零点六。速度点标在区间中点，连成直线。现在先别看新点：若规律继续，下一段多长？仍加零点六厘米，预测三点九厘米。新记录与预测吻合；这是模型证据，真实实验仍需测量核对。
cues.en: The cart pulls one tape through a timer with fixed ticks. Group five intervals: each strip represents one tenth of a second. Align the original strips. Their lengths are one point five, two point one, two point seven and three point three centimeters. Dividing by the same time gives successive velocities. Each gains zero point zero six meters per second. Divide again by the time interval: acceleration is zero point six. Plot velocities at interval midpoints to obtain a straight line. Before revealing the next strip, predict its length. Another zero point six centimeters gives three point nine. The new model record agrees; a real experiment still needs measured evidence.

cues.title: 下落更快，加速度变了吗？
cues.caption: 速度增加，加速度可以不变。
cues.captionEn: Velocity can grow at constant acceleration.
cues.zh: 换成竖直下落，纸带跟着重物走，计时规则不变。每零点一秒的段长是四点九、十四点七、二十四点五厘米。速度越来越大，但相邻段每次都增加九点八厘米。用这个增量除以时间间隔的平方，得到九点八米每二次方秒。若加速度继续不变，下一段应该是三十四点三厘米；新点验证了模型预测。最后把质量加倍：忽略空气和纸带阻力时，同一时刻两者下落一样远。这是理想预测，不能代替真实测量。
cues.en: Turn the record vertical. The tape follows a falling mass, with the same timing rule. At intervals of zero point one seconds, the gaps measure four point nine, fourteen point seven and twenty-four point five centimeters. Velocity grows, but each gap gains the same nine point eight centimeters. Divide that increment by the squared interval to obtain nine point eight meters per second squared. Continued constant acceleration predicts thirty-four point three centimeters next; the new mark agrees. Finally double the mass. Ignoring air and tape resistance, both fall the same distance in the same time. This ideal prediction does not replace real measurements.
